title: Frontend Developer

nodes.title: Internet & Browser Mechanics
nodes.subtitle: DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, Browser Rendering Engine, DOM tree vs Render tree
learning_objectives: Explain the journey of a URL from browser request to pixel rendering
Analyze critical rendering path and repaint/reflow triggers
feynman_prompts: Explain step-by-step what happens in the browser from typing a URL to seeing pixels.
key_misconceptions: Believing the browser downloads and executes all HTML/CSS/JS in a single synchronous pass

nodes.title: Semantic HTML5 & Accessibility (a11y)
nodes.subtitle: Accessible markup, ARIA roles, form validations, SEO metadata
learning_objectives: Structure pages with proper semantic landmarks (<main>, <nav>, <article>)
Implement keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes for screen readers
feynman_prompts: Why is a semantic <button> better for assistive technologies than a <div> with an onClick handler?
key_misconceptions: Treating accessibility as an optional post-launch enhancement rather than core web standard

nodes.title: CSS Box Model & Display Mechanics
nodes.subtitle: Content-box vs border-box, margin collapsing, inline vs block vs inline-block
learning_objectives: Calculate exact element dimensions using standard vs border-box models
Prevent and resolve vertical margin collapse issues
feynman_prompts: Explain why margins collapse vertically between sibling elements but paddings do not.
key_misconceptions: Assuming width: 100% includes padding and border without box-sizing: border-box

nodes.title: Modern CSS: Flexbox 1D Alignment
nodes.subtitle: Flex container properties, flex-grow, flex-shrink, flex-basis, alignment axes
learning_objectives: Build responsive navigation bars and centered hero sections using Flexbox
Control item resizing dynamics with flex-grow and flex-shrink
feynman_prompts: How do the main axis and cross axis change when flex-direction switches to column?
key_misconceptions: Confusing justify-content (main axis) with align-items (cross axis)

nodes.title: Modern CSS: 2D CSS Grid Mastery
nodes.subtitle: Grid template columns/rows, fr units, minmax, auto-fill vs auto-fit, grid areas
learning_objectives: Create fluid two-dimensional dashboard layouts without media queries
Design template area layouts with named grid lines
feynman_prompts: Explain the practical difference between auto-fill and auto-fit in a minmax grid.
key_misconceptions: Over-nesting Flexbox containers where a single CSS Grid would be simpler

nodes.title: Responsive Design & CSS Custom Properties
nodes.subtitle: Fluid clamping clamp(), media queries, container queries, CSS variables
learning_objectives: Implement dynamic theme switching using CSS custom properties
Create fluid typography without rigid pixel breakpoints using clamp()
feynman_prompts: Why are container queries more modular for reusable components than viewport media queries?
key_misconceptions: Hardcoding fixed pixel widths that break on small mobile devices

nodes.title: Utility-First Styling with Tailwind CSS
nodes.subtitle: Tailwind JIT, design tokens, responsive prefixes, component extraction
learning_objectives: Build complex responsive interfaces rapidly using Tailwind utility classes
Configure design theme tokens and dark mode variants
feynman_prompts: What are the performance and maintainability trade-offs of utility classes vs traditional BEM CSS?
key_misconceptions: Copying long repetitive class strings everywhere instead of extracting reusable UI components

nodes.title: JavaScript Types, Scopes & Closures
nodes.subtitle: Primitives vs reference types, execution context, lexical scope, closures
learning_objectives: Differentiate value copying from reference mutation in objects and arrays
Leverage lexical closures for data encapsulation and factory functions
feynman_prompts: Explain how a closure retains access to its outer scope variables even after the outer function returns.
key_misconceptions: Mutating object references unintentionally leading to side-effect bugs

nodes.title: Modern ES6+ Syntax & Array Methods
nodes.subtitle: Map, filter, reduce, destructuring, spread/rest, optional chaining, nullish coalescing
learning_objectives: Transform complex nested datasets declaratively using map, filter, and reduce
Use destructuring, optional chaining (?.), and nullish coalescing (??) safely
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between the || operator and the ?? (nullish coalescing) operator?
key_misconceptions: Using Array.prototype.map when no return value is needed instead of forEach or for-of

nodes.title: JavaScript Event Loop & Concurrency
nodes.subtitle: Call stack, Web APIs, task queue (macrotasks), microtask queue, Promise resolution
learning_objectives: Predict asynchronous code execution order between setTimeout, Promises, and sync code
Avoid blocking the single thread with heavy computational loops
feynman_prompts: Why does a resolved Promise callback run before a setTimeout(fn, 0) callback?
key_misconceptions: Thinking JavaScript is multi-threaded because of asynchronous async/await keywords

nodes.title: DOM Manipulation & Event Architecture
nodes.subtitle: querySelector, DOM mutations, event bubbling, event capturing, event delegation
learning_objectives: Implement high-performance event delegation on dynamic lists with 1,000+ items
Manipulate the DOM safely without triggering layout thrashing
feynman_prompts: How does event bubbling allow handling clicks on dynamic child elements from a single parent listener?
key_misconceptions: Attaching individual event listeners to hundreds of list items instead of using event delegation

nodes.title: Asynchronous JavaScript & Fetch API
nodes.subtitle: Promises, async/await, Fetch API, HTTP headers, status codes, error handling
learning_objectives: Handle asynchronous HTTP requests with robust try/catch and response.ok checks
Handle parallel requests efficiently using Promise.all and Promise.allSettled
feynman_prompts: Why does fetch() not reject its promise on HTTP 404 or 500 error status codes?
key_misconceptions: Forgetting to check response.ok when using fetch(), assuming HTTP errors throw automatically

nodes.title: Browser Storage & Client State Persistence
nodes.subtitle: localStorage, sessionStorage, Cookies (HttpOnly, SameSite), IndexedDB
learning_objectives: Persist user preferences in localStorage with JSON serialization
Evaluate security implications of storing auth tokens in localStorage vs HttpOnly cookies
feynman_prompts: Why are sensitive auth tokens stored in localStorage vulnerable to XSS attacks?
key_misconceptions: Storing large structured datasets synchronously in localStorage instead of IndexedDB

nodes.title: Version Control (Git) & Package Managers
nodes.subtitle: Git branching, merge vs rebase, npm vs pnpm vs yarn, semantic versioning
learning_objectives: Manage feature branches and resolve merge conflicts using Git
Manage dependencies and lockfiles using pnpm/npm with semantic versioning
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between dependencies and devDependencies in package.json?
key_misconceptions: Manually deleting or editing package-lock.json when resolving dependency conflicts

nodes.title: React Component Architecture & JSX
nodes.subtitle: Virtual DOM, JSX compilation, unidirectional data flow, pure components, props
learning_objectives: Structure reusable component hierarchies with clean separation of concerns
Pass data and callbacks cleanly through props without prop drilling
feynman_prompts: Why must React components and render outputs be pure functions with respect to their props?
key_misconceptions: Directly mutating state variables instead of calling setState or dispatch

nodes.title: React Hooks: useState, useEffect & useRef
nodes.subtitle: Reactivity, dependency array rules, cleanup functions, DOM references
learning_objectives: Manage local component state with useState and useReducer
Manage side-effects and cleanup subscriptions correctly with useEffect
feynman_prompts: Why does omitting a reactive variable from the useEffect dependency array lead to stale closure bugs?
key_misconceptions: Using useEffect for data transformation that could be calculated synchronously during render

nodes.title: TypeScript Fundamentals for UI Engineers
nodes.subtitle: Type inference, interfaces vs types, generics, typing React props and events
learning_objectives: Type React components, custom hooks, and synthetic browser events strictly
Use generics to build type-safe UI components like dropdowns and tables
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between a TypeScript interface and a type alias when building component props?
key_misconceptions: Overusing 'any' type to silence compiler errors instead of writing proper type definitions

nodes.title: Client-Side Routing & SPA Architecture
nodes.subtitle: HTML5 History API, React Router / TanStack Router, route parameters, protected routes
learning_objectives: Configure client-side routing with nested layouts and dynamic URL parameters
Implement route guards and redirect unauthenticated users cleanly
feynman_prompts: How does client-side routing manipulate browser history without reloading the page from the server?
key_misconceptions: Using <a> tags instead of <Link> components, causing full page refreshes

nodes.title: Server State & Caching with TanStack Query
nodes.subtitle: Query keys, staleTime vs gcTime, mutations, optimistic updates, query invalidation
learning_objectives: Decouple remote server data caching from local client UI state
Implement optimistic updates with automatic rollback on network failure
feynman_prompts: Why is it an anti-pattern to copy server response data into global Redux/Zustand state stores?
key_misconceptions: Refetching data manually in useEffect instead of using declarative query caching

nodes.title: Global Client State: Zustand & Context API
nodes.subtitle: Context API trade-offs, Zustand stores, selectors, immutable state updates
learning_objectives: Manage cross-cutting client UI state (modals, active themes, cart) with Zustand
Optimize rendering performance using fine-grained store selectors
feynman_prompts: Why does updating React Context trigger re-renders in all consuming components regardless of selector?
key_misconceptions: Putting high-frequency server data into global client stores

nodes.title: Build Tools, Bundlers & Vite
nodes.subtitle: ES modules in development, Rollup production bundling, tree-shaking, code splitting
learning_objectives: Configure code-splitting using dynamic import() for faster initial page loads
Analyze and reduce production bundle sizes using bundle analyzer tools
feynman_prompts: Explain how tree-shaking removes dead exports from production JavaScript bundles.
key_misconceptions: Importing an entire monolithic library when only a single utility function is needed

nodes.title: Frontend Testing: Unit & Component Testing
nodes.subtitle: Vitest, React Testing Library, testing accessible roles, mocking network calls
learning_objectives: Write resilient component tests querying elements by accessible roles (getByRole)
Mock network API responses cleanly with Mock Service Worker (MSW)
feynman_prompts: Why should component tests verify user behavior rather than internal component implementation details?
key_misconceptions: Testing implementation details like internal state variable names that break on refactors

nodes.title: Web Performance & Core Web Vitals
nodes.subtitle: LCP, INP, CLS, critical rendering path, image optimization, font display swap
learning_objectives: Diagnose and eliminate layout shifts (CLS) caused by unsized media
Optimize Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) with priority resource hints
feynman_prompts: How do unsized image elements cause Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)?
key_misconceptions: Loading heavy third-party tracking scripts synchronously in the document <head>

nodes.title: Web Security: XSS, CSRF, CSP & CORS
nodes.subtitle: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), CSRF tokens, Content Security Policy, CORS preflight
learning_objectives: Sanitize user-generated content to prevent stored and reflected XSS attacks
Configure strict Content Security Policy (CSP) headers and understand CORS preflight requests
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between CORS (browser-enforced policy) and actual server-side authentication?
key_misconceptions: Assuming CORS prevents malicious attackers from querying backend APIs with tools like curl

description: Master Frontend Developer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 24 core and advanced milestones.
